Speaker: Priya Raman (Researcher)
Text: Thanks for making the time today, Daniel. I'll record this so I don't miss anything.

Speaker: Daniel Okafor
Text: No problem at all, happy to help.

Speaker: Priya Raman (Researcher)
Text: To start, how do you currently share insights with your stakeholders?

Speaker: Daniel Okafor
Text: Mostly PowerPoint. I export charts from the survey tool, paste them into slides, and then rewrite the takeaways by hand. It takes me most of a Friday.

Speaker: Daniel Okafor
Text: Sometimes I'll send a raw CSV to the analysts if they want to slice it themselves.

Speaker: Priya Raman (Researcher)
Text: What is the most frustrating part of that process?

Speaker: Daniel Okafor
Text: The rework. Every time the data refreshes I have to redo the slides, and there's no way to tell whether the numbers in last month's deck are still accurate.

Speaker: Priya Raman (Researcher)
Text: Got it. How often do you need to combine data from more than one source?

Speaker: Daniel Okafor
Text: Almost every study. We pull survey responses, support tickets, and NPS from a separate platform. Joining them is manual work in a spreadsheet.

Speaker: Priya Raman (Researcher)
Text: Makes sense. What would a good dashboard need to have for you to trust it?

Speaker: Daniel Okafor
Text: Clear filters, a visible last-refreshed timestamp, and the ability to click a number and see the responses behind it.
